<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex034042026-11-1311-04-21" status="reviewed">2 pa bsgyur ba ni 
            a rgya na 'phags pa'o  || 
            mu la zhes yod na gzhi'o  ||  
            sa r+ba na <expan>thams cad</expan> do  ||  
            as sti b+ha d+ha na yod par smra ba'o  ||  
            shra ma ne ra dge' tshul lo | 
            ka ri ka ni tshig le'ur byas pa'o || </seg></TEI>
